'''Anymna''', officially the '''Federal Republic of Anymna''', is a country in north [[Quia]]. It is mainly situated in the [[Kertesen]] mountain range. It borders [[Zhanshe]] to the north, [[Ztesh]] and [[Yihnurda]] to the west, and [[Onphello]] to the east, with the northern [[Eanif ocean]] to the north. Anymna has a diverse geography, including [[wikipedia:Plain|fertile plains]], forested hills, and one of the world's [[List of highest mountains on Andah|ten tallest mountains]]. [[Khureldai]] is the nation's capital and its largest city. Anymna is a multi-ethnic, multi-lingual, multi-religious, and multi-cultural state, with [[Anymnan language|Anymnan]] as the official language. The name "Anymna" is first recorded in texts from the famous [[Taval|Tavalan]] explorer [[Breturside Klou|Breturside]] in 1333.

Early civilisations in the area included the [[Sursia|Sursian]]-speaking city-states along the coast. In the 9th century, the [[Carraam peoples|Carraam]] people [[wikipedia:Migration|migrated]] across from modern-day [[Onphello]] into [[Sursia]], and following the establishment of the [[Navulnotan Empire]] in the 900s, the [[Anymnan language]] and culture became dominant in the country. The [[Navulnotan Empire]] fell to internal strife and the rise of the [[Creau Empire]] in the twelfth century, with several warring states emerging. In the 13th century, reunified by the [[Cogean Confederation]]. The late 15th-century [[Riaoscoyq Kingdom]] ruled over an area that included modern Anymnan. [[Emara]] seized control of the administration of Anymna after [[Emaran-Anymnan wars|two Wars]] in the 17th century, and the country became an [[Emara|Emaran]] colony. On the last day of 1695, Anymna declared independence under the terms of the [[Treaty of Freedom]].

Anymna's post-independence history has been checkered by continuing [[wikipedia:Civil_disorder| unrest]] and conflict to this day. The [[wikipedia:Coup_d%27%C3%A9tat|coup d'état]] in 1712 resulted in a [[wikipedia:Military_dictatorship|military dictatorship]] under the [[Anymna Socialist Party]]. In 1726, the [[Khureldai Uprising]] resulted in a nominal transition to a multi-party system two years later, but the country's post-uprising [[Anymna military council|military council]] refused to cede power. The country remains riven by [[wikipedia:Ethnic_conflict|ethnic strife]] among its eastern provinces. The [[Quian Union]] and several other organisations have reported consistent and systemic [[wikipedia:Human_rights|human rights violations]] in the eastern provinces . In 1749, the [[wikipedia:Military_junta|military junta]] was officially dissolved following a [[1747 Anymnan general election|1747 general election]], and a nominally civilian government was installed. [[wikipedia:Political_prisoner|Political prisoners]] were released and the [[1753 Anymnan general election|1753 general election]] was held, leading to improved foreign relations and eased [[wikipedia:Economic_sanctions|economic sanctions]], although the country's treatment of its [[wikipedia:Minority_group|ethnic minorities]], particularly in connection with the [[Reunci conflict]], continued to be a source of international tension and consternation. 

The [[Constitution of Anymna]], adopted in 1755, affirms the country as a [[wikipedia:Federal_republic|federal presidential republic]] divided into forty-four provinces. Anymna was admitted to the [[Global Trade Union]] in 1732, and friendship treaties were signed with [[Ztesh]] in 1744. which it is a founding member. Anymna is also a member of the [[SIAO]] group.
